summary.text: Spindle 3 temperature reached 64.2 against the 60.0 validated limit (4.2 over), critical alert open. Lot TM-HS12-261120-190 has 4 parts at risk. QA hold is required: quarantine them, send them to CMM and open an NCR. Alert event history was unavailable.

quarantine.rationale: These 4 of 15 parts in the lot were cut while Spindle 3 was outside its validated limit. The rule requires a QA hold. The lot row lists the other 11 parts as releasable.

cmm_inspection.scope: CMM-inspect the 4 at-risk parts for stem taper and neck geometry, the risk named in the rule. No CMM results exist yet. QA may widen the scope if the results are marginal.

ncr.rationale: A validated process parameter (Spindle 3 temperature, limit 60 °C) was exceeded and the rule requires an NCR. Proposed NCR id: NCR-20261120-155121-CBAB.

maintenance_request.rationale: Temperature rose past 60 and was still 61.0 to 63.1 in the last bucket. The last spindle inspection on record was 2026-09-01, including thermal compensation re-verification. Request a spindle check.

risk_narrative.text: The model scored this alert 87%, which is high. The largest contributor was the 5-minute spindle temperature slope (0.41), followed by vibration RMS (0.22). The score is advisory and does not replace CMM results.

steps.action: Quarantine the at-risk parts of lot TM-HS12-261120-190 (serials listed in the disposition) under QA hold. A qualified person signs the decision in the app.
Request CMM inspection of the 4 at-risk parts for stem taper and neck geometry before any disposition.
Open NCR-20261120-155121-CBAB for the Spindle 3 temperature excursion (64.2 against the 60.0 limit), referencing DHR-TM-HS12-261120-190.
Inspect Spindle 3 for the cause of the temperature rise and check thermal compensation. The last inspection on record was 2026-09-01.
Hold further Spindle 3 cuts until Maintenance and QA confirm temperature is back within the validated limit. The last reading bucket was still above 60.
Assess the excursion against PS-TM-MILL-HS-003 rev C, PQ-TM-HS12-022 and OQ-TM-CNC1-014, and say whether revalidation or a process change is needed.
Use the CMM results to disposition the lot. Projected right-first-time is 42.86% (3 good of 7 started). The alert event history was unavailable, so confirm the excursion timeline from source records.
